name: hybrid-forge
description: Autonomous plan-and-execute coding loop. A daemon owns the state machine and drives whichever models you bring; Claude plans and reviews, a cheaper model builds.

executorKind.description: Adapter for the interactive delegation tool: openai (covers Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, LiteLLM, OpenRouter, OpenAI), anthropic, gemini, command, or claude-cli. Per-project roles live in .hybridforge/config.json and take precedence over this.

executorBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the executor model when executorKind is an HTTP adapter (e.g. http://forge-host:11434/v1)

executorModel.description: Model tag served by the executor host

memPalaceUrl.description: URL of the centrally hosted MemPalace MCP endpoint
